height.description: The height of the person in centimeters.

system.description: The system of units to be used, 'metric' or 'imperial'. Default is 'metric'.

Given heights in cm; convert to meters dividing by 100.

Third: 80 kg, 175cm->1.75m. BMI=80/(1.75^2)=80/3.0625≈26.12.

Fourth: 90 kg, 185cm->1.85m. BMI=90/(1.85^2)=90/3.4225≈26.32.
